description: cfd_2d_dambreak_amr3_adapt with the one-step scheme with two projections (N 40 6) on two adaptive levels: cfd_amr::step_comp with the half step of all levels and the composite projection with dt/2, the level set of all levels with u(n+1/2), the mid-step level set around the patches, the full step and the composite projection with dt.
covers: cfd_amr::step_comp: N 40 6 (mom_block 0, ls_block, amr_twoproj_mid, mom_block 1, end_block)
momentum_rk::amr_twoproj_momentum on the patches, the Crank-Nicolson diffusion with u(n) around the patches
